# Lesson 13

©Listening

A Listen and number the photos

（1-6）.

- Sally told Mr Wu that she_ a was hungry b liked to cook c was in the kitchen
- Who influenced Sally to cook? a Her neighbour. b Her mother. c Her uncle.
- Mr Wu thinks it is a pity that a Sally works in the restaurant b the restaurant is so far away c he can't go to the city
- Sally said that it was to have a successful restaurant.

B What did they say? Listen and choose the correct words.

Unit 5 Memories

C Sally is talking to her neighbour.

Listen to their conversation and circle the correct answer.

a difficult b easy

e fun

5 For New Year, Sally mentioned that she would

a eat at the restaurant b cook with her uncle c buy some jiaozi

- My mum told me that I forgot / would remember the words.
- Bobby told me that he would eat / was eating his dinner.
- Miss Lin mentioned that she gave / would give everybody a grade on their projects.
- Karen said that she would go / went to the lake on Friday.
- Dad told me that he was walking / walked to the shop.

• Translation

Translate the sentences into English.

- 我姑姑对我影响很大。
- 他说你今晚会复习功课。
- 阅读对我来说是一种乐趣。
- 他告诉我一切都会好起来。
- 谁曾鼓厨你当教师？
- 遇到困难的时候，妈妈总是陪在我身边。
